# wcpfcNSWO R Package

`wcpfcNSWO` is an R package supporting the Management Strategy
Evaluation (MSE) for North Pacific swordfish, managed by the Western and
Central Pacific Fisheries Commission (WCPFC). It provides the operating
models, management procedures, performance metrics, and all related data
and code used to evaluate the candidate management procedures against a
range of plausible operating models for the stock and fishery.

See the [project homepage](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/) for
an overview of the MSE materials, and the [Trial Specifications
Document](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/tsd/) for full details
of the operating models, management procedures, and performance metrics
used in the MSE.

## Installation

You can install the `wcpfcNSWO` package from its [GitHub
repository](https://github.com/Blue-Matter/wcpfcNSWO) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Blue-Matter/wcpfcNSWO")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Calc_FTarget_FMSY()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Calc_FTarget_FMSY.md)
  : F Target Relative to FMSY
- [`Calc_PM_Stats()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Calc_PM_Stats.md)
  : Per-Simulation Performance Indicators
- [`Extract_MSE_Timeseries()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/Extract_MSE_Timeseries.md)
  : Annual Time Series from an MSE
- [`ListSS3Runs()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/ListSS3Runs.md)
  : Create a data frame with details of SS3 Models
- [`PM_SafetyNoBreach()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_SafetyNoBreach.md)
  : Probability Spawning Biomass Remains Above the Limit Reference Point
- [`PM_StatusF()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_StatusF.md)
  : Probability Fishing Mortality is at or Below the F Target
- [`PM_Window_Years()`](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/pkg/reference/PM_Window_Years.md)
  : Years for a Performance Metric Window
